entries.name: cancel-sheet
entries.title: Cancellation
entries.summary: Three steps to cancel: tell us why (Proceed stays disabled until there is text), confirm, and the request submitted with access kept until the end date.
entries.text:
# Cancellation (`cancel-sheet`)
Group: Monetization

Three steps to cancel: tell us why (Proceed stays disabled until there is text), confirm, and the request submitted with access kept until the end date.

- React: `import { CancelSheet } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `CancelSheet`
- Tokens: `gradient/status-neutral`, `button/primary`, `stroke/subtle`
- Source: Monetization Flow · cancellation

Props of `CancelSheet`:
- `step`: `'feedback' | 'confirm' | 'submitted'`. Step.
- `accessUntil?`: `string` = '15 June 2026'. Access end date.
- `reason / onReasonChange?`: `string / (v) => void`. Feedback text (controlled or not).
- `onProceed / onKeep / onConfirm / onRedirect?`: `() => void`. Step actions.

Do: Say how long access lasts at every step.

Don't: Don't make Proceed tappable before the user writes a reason.

Anatomy:
1. Scrim: Dimmed layer behind the sheet. It takes taps but does not close the sheet. (scrim · full-size layer · no close action)
2. Sheet panel: Bottom panel that holds the status card and footer (StatusSheet). (bg/surface · radius 24 top (24 all round inline) · padding 12/12/20 · shadow 0 -8 30 black/12%)
3. Status card: Neutral ring card with the 3D art: sad face for feedback and confirm, thumbs up when submitted. (gradient/status-neutral · radius 20 · 1dp stroke/subtle · padding 18/16 · art 100dp)
4. Title lines: Two display lines, light line first: 'We're Sad to / See you Cancel', 'Are you really / Sure?', 'Your Request is / Submitted'. (light 22/26 Regular · strong 28/32 Bold, -0.02em · text/primary · centred)
5. Body: Says when access ends and what happens to autopay. (body1 · text/secondary · centred · 8 above)
6. Reason field (feedback): Three-line text area for the reason for cancelling. (radius 12 · 1dp stroke/subtle, action/stroke/unread when focused · bg/surface · padding 12/14 · body1)
7. Footer: Proceed (disabled until there is text); or Cancel (outline) + Confirm; or the 3s redirect note. (Button lg block · gap 12 · RedirectNote body2 text/action · footer padding 16 top, 8 sides)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: The panel is role="dialog" with aria-modal in overlay mode. The title lines are plain divs, not headings. Android: The panel sets semantics { paneTitle = label }. The title lines are plain text with no heading().
- Name. Web: aria-label per step: 'Cancel subscription', 'Confirm cancellation', 'Request submitted'. The textarea is labelled 'Why are you cancelling?'. Android: paneTitle uses the same three labels. The reason field has contentDescription 'Why are you cancelling?'.
- Keyboard. Web: No Escape handler, no close button, and focus is not moved into the sheet or trapped there. Tab reaches the textarea and the footer buttons. Android: TalkBack: swipe through the card, field and buttons, double-tap to activate. There is no BackHandler, so system Back does not close the sheet.
- Touch target. Web: lg buttons are 45px tall with no eq-touch, so they fall just short of 48. Android: EqualButton applies minimumInteractiveComponentSize, so the 45dp buttons get a 48dp target.
- Contrast. Web: Body text/secondary on the neutral gradient passes. White on green for Proceed/Confirm and the green outline Cancel label are 2.85:1 in light, which fails. In dark they are black on lime and lime on #222. Android: Same tokens: the light-mode primary and outline buttons are 2.85:1 and fail AA. Dark passes.
- State. Web: Proceed uses the native disabled attribute until there is text, so it drops out of the tab order with no reason given. The redirect countdown is aria-live="polite". Android: Proceed is enabled = false, which TalkBack reads as 'disabled'. RedirectNote is a polite liveRegion.
- Motion. Web: The panel rises in with eq-sheet-up (320ms). Under prefers-reduced-motion the animation is turned off. Android: The panel slides up 40% and fades in over motion.slow. This is not gated on rememberReduceMotion(); only the title rise is.

Known accessibility gaps:
- CancelSheet (Monetization.tsx / Monetization.kt): the feedback step has no way out. There is no close button, the scrim does nothing, and neither Escape (web) nor Back (Android) dismisses it.
- StatusSheet in Monetization.tsx does not move focus into the dialog, trap it, or return it on close.
- StatusCard title lines (Monetization.tsx / Monetization.kt) are not headings, so screen readers get no heading for each step.
- Proceed in CancelSheet (Monetization.tsx) uses native disabled, so keyboard users can't reach it and nothing explains that a reason is required. Use aria-disabled plus a hint instead.
- RedirectNote (Monetization.tsx / .kt) redirects after 3s with no way to pause, and its polite live region announces every second.
- StatusSheet in Monetization.kt: the enter slide/fade is not gated on rememberReduceMotion().
- The lg Buttons in the CancelSheet footer are 45px tall on web with no eq-touch, so they are under 48 (Button.tsx).
- The outline Cancel label (text/action #00B140 on white) and RedirectNote text are 2.85:1 in light mode, below 4.5:1.
- Primary buttons put text/on-action white on button/primary #00B140 in light mode: 2.85:1, below AA 4.5:1 for 14sp text (Button.css / Buttons.kt). Dark (black on lime) is 17.4:1.

Example: Feedback
```tsx
<CancelSheet step="feedback" reason={reason} onReasonChange={setReason} onProceed={next} />
```
```kotlin
var reason by remember { mutableStateOf("") }
CancelSheet(step = CancelStep.Feedback, reason = reason, onReasonChange = { reason = it },
    onProceed = { /* next step */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Feedback filled
```tsx
<CancelSheet step="feedback" reason="Felt it too expensive…" onReasonChange={setReason} onProceed={next} />
```
```kotlin
var reason by remember { mutableStateOf("Felt it too expensive, I hope it would be under my budget") }
CancelSheet(step = CancelStep.Feedback, reason = reason, onReasonChange = { reason = it },
    onProceed = { /* next step */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Are you really sure?
```tsx
<CancelSheet step="confirm" accessUntil="15 June 2026" onKeep={close} onConfirm={cancel} />
```
```kotlin
CancelSheet(step = CancelStep.Confirm, accessUntil = "15 June 2026", onKeep = { /* close */ },
    onConfirm = { /* cancel subscription */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Request submitted
```tsx
<CancelSheet step="submitted" accessUntil="15 June 2026" onRedirect={goHome} />
```
```kotlin
CancelSheet(step = CancelStep.Submitted, accessUntil = "15 June 2026", onRedirect = { /* go home */ }, inline = true)
```

entries.name: coupon-ticket
entries.title: Coupon ticket
entries.summary: A notched ticket with the coupon code, what it saves, APPLY / APPLIED and the big discount line.
entries.text:
# Coupon ticket (`coupon-ticket`)
Group: Monetization

A notched ticket with the coupon code, what it saves, APPLY / APPLIED and the big discount line.

- React: `import { CouponTicket } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `CouponTicket`
- Tokens: `gradient/coupon`, `paywall/card-stroke`, `paywall/divider`, `text/gold`, `gradient/gold-text`
- Source: Monetization Flow · EQUAL25

Props of `CouponTicket`:
- `code`: `string`. Coupon code.
- `description`: `ReactNode`. What it saves.
- `discount`: `string`. Big gold line, e.g. "25% OFF".
- `applied?`: `boolean`. Shows APPLIED; the price above drops.
- `onApply?`: `() => void`. APPLY tap.

Do: Drop the price in PriceTag when the coupon applies (₹249 → ₹149).

Don't: Don't show more than one coupon at a time.

Anatomy:
1. Ticket: Notched card. (radius 20 · 9 dp notches at 58% height · gradient/coupon · 1 px paywall/card-stroke · padding 14 16 12)
2. Code: The coupon code. (subheading Bold · text/gold)
3. Description: What it saves. (caption Regular · text/secondary)
4. APPLY / APPLIED: Apply action, then its applied state. (buttonSmall Bold · text/gold · padding-top 4)
5. Dashed rule and seal: Divider with the 3D % seal. (1 px dashed paywall/divider · seal 28 · gap 10)
6. Discount: Big discount line. (30/36 Bold · gradient/gold-text · centred)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: APPLY is a <button>; APPLIED is a span with aria-live="polite"; the seal is alt="". Android: APPLY text clickable(role = Role.Button); APPLIED has liveRegion = Polite; seal has no contentDescription.
- Name. Web: Button reads "APPLY" with no code; should say "Apply EQUAL25". Android: Button reads "APPLY"; the code is a separate text node.
- Keyboard. Web: Tab to APPLY; Enter/Space. When applied the button is removed and focus is lost. Android: TalkBack: swipe to APPLY, double-tap.
- Touch target. Web: APPLY uses eq-touch for a 48 px hit area. Android: APPLY uses minimumInteractiveComponentSize (48 dp).
- Contrast. Web: Code and APPLY text/gold #8C5817 on #FFF4DE 5.5:1; description text/secondary 6.8:1; discount gradient top is about 3.2:1 (large text). Dark: gold 8.6:1. Android: Same tokens.
- State. Web: Applied swaps APPLY for the word APPLIED (not colour); the live region is mounted with the text, so it may not be announced. Android: Applied swaps the text; the polite live region announces it.
- Motion. Web: Static; the price drop above it animates in PriceTag. Android: Static.

Known accessibility gaps:
- APPLY has no coupon context in its name; use aria-label / contentDescription "Apply EQUAL25" (Monetization.tsx, Monetization.kt).
- APPLIED live region is created in the same render as its text, so screen readers often skip it; keep a persistent live region (Monetization.tsx).
- When APPLY is replaced by APPLIED, keyboard focus is lost (Monetization.tsx).

Example: Available
```tsx
<CouponTicket code="EQUAL25" description="Save Flat ₹100 with this Code" discount="25% OFF" onApply={apply} />
```
```kotlin
CouponTicket(code = "EQUAL25", description = "Save Flat ₹100 with this Code", discount = "25% OFF", onApply = {})
```

Example: Applied
```tsx
<CouponTicket code="EQUAL25" description="Save Flat ₹100 with this Code" discount="25% OFF" applied />
```
```kotlin
CouponTicket(code = "EQUAL25", description = "Save Flat ₹100 with this Code", discount = "25% OFF", applied = true)
```

entries.name: discount-badge
entries.title: Discount badge & price drop
entries.summary: The green 25% OFF seal with its label, and the price drop it rides on: APPLY strikes the old price, the new price lands beside the list price with Saved ₹100, then the badge pops.
entries.text:
# Discount badge & price drop (`discount-badge`)
Group: Monetization

The green 25% OFF seal with its label, and the price drop it rides on: APPLY strikes the old price, the new price lands beside the list price with Saved ₹100, then the badge pops.

- React: `import { DiscountBadge, PriceTag } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `DiscountBadge`, `PriceTag`
- Tokens: `text/brand`, `gradient/gold-text`
- Source: Monetization local components

Props of `DiscountBadge`:
- `label?`: `string` = 'Discounted!!'. Green label.
- `off?`: `string` = '25%'. Seal text.
- `animate?`: `boolean`. Pop in.

Props of `PriceTag`:
- `price`: `number`. Price now.
- `was?`: `number`. Struck list price; adds /Monthly and Saved ₹.
- `badge?`: `string`. A DiscountBadge under the price.
- `animate?`: `boolean`. Run the strike → land → pop sequence (still under reduced motion).

Do: Animate only when the user caused the change (APPLY).

Don't: Don't animate a price that was already discounted when the page opened.

Anatomy:
1. DiscountBadge pill: White pill that holds the seal and its label. (radius full · bg/surface · padding 2/10/2/2 · gap 6 · shadow 0 2 10 black 8%)
2. OffSeal: Coded green wavy seal with the discount. (28dp · 12 lobes · text/brand fill · '25%' over 'OFF' Bold text/on-action)
3. Label: What the discount is. (caption Bold · text/brand · 'Discounted!!' or 'Special Coupon Applied!')
4. PriceTag: label: Promotion line over the price. (caption uppercase · text/gold · 🎊 emoji either side (aria-hidden on web))
5. PriceTag: price: Big gold price between hairlines. (44/48 Bold · gradient/gold-text · paywall/divider fading rules · gap 16)
6. PriceTag: was + period: Struck list price and the period beside the price. (14 Medium tabular, struck · '/Monthly' 14 · text/secondary · gap 6 on the baseline)
7. PriceTag: saved line: How much the user saves. ('Saved ₹100' · caption Bold · text/brand)
8. Strike line: Gold bar that strikes the old price during the drop. (3dp · text/gold · 108% wide · 52% down · radius 2 · animation only)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: DiscountBadge is role=status (polite live region); OffSeal is an aria-hidden svg; PriceTag is plain text. Android: DiscountBadge uses clearAndSetSemantics with liveRegion Polite; the struck price has its own contentDescription.
- Name. Web: The badge reads only the label ('Discounted!!') because the seal is hidden, so '25% off' is lost. The price reads '₹149 ₹249 /Monthly'; strikethrough isn't announced. Android: Badge reads '25% off. Discounted!!'; the struck price reads 'was ₹249 /Monthly'.
- Contrast. Web: Label and Saved line (text/brand) and the seal's white text are 2.85:1 in light (fail); dark is lime with black text, 17:1. Gold price gradient is 3.5–7.3:1 on white, fine for 44 px text; text/gold label 6:1. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: The discount is in text (seal, label, struck price, Saved ₹), not colour. During the drop only the badge, as a live region, announces the change. Android: Same; the badge's live region announces when it appears.
- Motion. Web: Strike draws at 300ms over 450ms, new price lands at 800ms (motion.priceDrop), badge pops with a spring after 120ms and the seal spins in. Under prefers-reduced-motion the CSS animations stop, but the timed old → strike → done swap still runs. Android: Same sequence; under rememberReduceMotion the final state shows at once.

Known accessibility gaps:
- DiscountBadge in Monetization.tsx hides the OffSeal (aria-hidden), so screen readers hear 'Discounted!!' without '25% off'.
- PriceTag in Monetization.tsx gives the struck list price no 'was' text; Monetization.kt already adds one.
- text/brand label and Saved line, and the seal's white text on text/brand, are 2.85:1 in light theme.
- PriceTag in Monetization.tsx still waits through the old → strike → done phases (about 0.8s) under reduced motion; it should jump to done like Compose.

Example: Badges
```tsx
<DiscountBadge />
<DiscountBadge label="Special Coupon Applied!" />
```
```kotlin
Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    DiscountBadge()
    DiscountBadge(label = "Special Coupon Applied!")
}
```

Example: Price drop
```tsx
<PriceTag price={149} was={249} badge="Special Coupon Applied!" animate={justApplied} />
```
```kotlin
var replay by remember { mutableIntStateOf(0) }
Column(horizontalAlignment = Alignment.CenterHorizontally, verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    // Strike the old price → land the new one with "Saved ₹100" → pop the badge
    key(replay) {
        PriceTag(price = "149", was = 249, badge = "Special Coupon Applied!", animate = true)
    }
    EqualButton(text = "Replay", onClick = { replay++ }, variant = EqualButtonVariant.Secondary, size = EqualButtonSize.Sm)
}
```

entries.name: faq
entries.title: FAQ
entries.summary: The FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS accordion on the paywall and the subscription page, and the hairline section label it sits under.
entries.text:
# FAQ (`faq`)
Group: Monetization

The FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS accordion on the paywall and the subscription page, and the hairline section label it sits under.

- React: `import { FaqList, DividerLabel } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `FaqList`, `DividerLabel`
- Tokens: `bg/surface`, `stroke/subtle`, `paywall/divider`, `text/secondary`
- Source: Monetization Flow · FAQ

Props of `FaqList`:
- `items`: `{ q: string; a: ReactNode }[]`. Questions.
- `title?`: `string | null` = 'Frequently asked questions'. Label above.
- `defaultOpen?`: `number[]` = []. Expanded rows.

Do: Answer cancellation and refunds plainly.

Don't: Don't put the FAQ above the CTA.

Anatomy:
1. DividerLabel: Section label between two gold hairlines. (1dp paywall/divider rules · gap 12 · caption uppercase +0.02em · text/primary (gold tone text/gold))
2. Card: One card that holds every question. (radius 16 · bg/surface · 1dp stroke/subtle · 14 below the label)
3. Question row: FaqEntry button that opens and closes the answer. (padding 16/14 · bodyLarge text/primary · gap 12)
4. Chevron: Shows whether the row is open. (chevron-down 20 · text/secondary · rotated 180 when open · decorative)
5. Answer: The answer, shown only while open. (body1 · text/secondary · padding 0 16 14)
6. Row divider: Hairline between questions. (1dp stroke/subtle)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: Each question is a button with aria-expanded inside a section; DividerLabel is plain text, not a heading. Android: Question row is clickable(Role.Button) with stateDescription; DividerLabel is plain text.
- Name. Web: The question text; the chevron icon is aria-hidden. Android: The question text; the chevron has contentDescription null.
- Keyboard. Web: Tab to each question, Enter/Space toggles; the answer follows the button in reading order. Android: TalkBack reads 'question, Collapsed, Button'; double-tap toggles.
- Touch target. Web: Full-width rows about 52 px tall. Android: Full-width rows about 52dp tall.
- Contrast. Web: Question text/primary; answer and chevron text/secondary 7.5:1 on white, #BBBBBB on #222222 8.3:1 in dark. Gold label tone text/gold is 6:1 on white. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: Open state is aria-expanded plus the visible answer and chevron rotation, not colour. Android: stateDescription 'Expanded' / 'Collapsed' plus the visible answer; open rows survive configuration changes.
- Motion. Web: No animation; the chevron flips and the answer appears instantly. Android: No animation.

Known accessibility gaps:
- DividerLabel (Monetization.tsx and Monetization.kt) is plain text, so the FAQ section title can't be reached by heading navigation.
- FaqEntry in Monetization.tsx has aria-expanded but no aria-controls linking the button to its answer.

Example: Accordion
```tsx
<FaqList items={faq} defaultOpen={[3]} />
```
```kotlin
val faq = listOf(
    FaqItem("What do I get with Equal Unlimited?", "Unlimited call screenings, full recordings, summaries, and zero daily cap."),
    FaqItem("Will Equal screen all types of calls?", "Yes! Delivery, ride pickups, spam, loan calls, Equal handles them all."),
    FaqItem("Can I cancel my Equal Unlimited plan later?", "Yes, cancel anytime. Your Unlimited access stays active until the end of your billing period."),
    FaqItem("Will I get a refund if I’m not happy with Equal Unlimited?", "We don’t offer refunds, but you can write to our support team and we’ll do our best to help."),
)
FaqList(items = faq, defaultOpen = listOf(3))
```

Example: Section label
```tsx
<DividerLabel>Why people choose</DividerLabel>
```
```kotlin
DividerLabel(text = "Why people choose")
```

entries.name: feature-list
entries.title: Feature list
entries.summary: What You Get on the plan page: one card per Unlimited feature with its 3D gold icon (24/7 Unlimited Call Screening, Unlimited Recordings, Unlimited Summaries).
entries.text:
# Feature list (`feature-list`)
Group: Monetization

What You Get on the plan page: one card per Unlimited feature with its 3D gold icon (24/7 Unlimited Call Screening, Unlimited Recordings, Unlimited Summaries).

- React: `import { FeatureList, unlimitedFeatures } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `FeatureList`
- Tokens: `stroke/subtle`, `bg/surface`
- Source: Monetization value · Manage Plan

Props of `FeatureList`:
- `items?`: `{ art: AssetName; label: string }[]` = unlimitedFeatures. Features, top to bottom; art is a 3D feature-* asset.

Do: Keep labels to one line. Use the 3D feature-* art; add a new asset for a new feature.

Don't: Don't swap in flat Material icons here. Don't list more than five; the page already has FAQ and proof.

Anatomy:
1. List: The stack of Unlimited features under What You Get. (web ul · Compose Column · gap 10)
2. Card: One card per feature. (radius 12 · bg/surface · 1dp stroke/subtle · padding 14/16 · gap 12)
3. Art: 3D gold feature icon. (28dp feature-* asset (call-screening, recordings, summaries) · decorative)
4. Label: The feature, on one line. (subheading Regular · text/primary)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: A ul of li items, so screen readers announce a list of N items. Android: A plain Column of Rows with no collection semantics.
- Name. Web: The label text; art has alt=''. Android: The label text; art has contentDescription null.
- Keyboard. Web: Not interactive; no Tab stops. Android: Not interactive; TalkBack reads each label in order.
- Contrast. Web: text/primary on bg/surface in both themes; the card border is decorative. Android: Same tokens as web.

Known accessibility gaps:
- FeatureList in PlanValue.kt has no list semantics (collectionInfo), so TalkBack doesn't say how many features there are.

Example: What You Get
```tsx
<DividerLabel>What You Get</DividerLabel>
<FeatureList items={unlimitedFeatures} />
```
```kotlin
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(16.dp)) {
    DividerLabel(text = "What You Get")
    FeatureList(items = UnlimitedFeatures)
}
```

entries.title: Help Center sheet

entries.text:
# Help Center sheet (`help-center-sheet`)
Group: Monetization

Opened from Support on the paywall (or Contact Support after a pending payment): call or mail the team.

- React: `import { HelpCenterSheet } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `HelpCenterSheet`
- Tokens: `bg/surface`, `stroke/subtle`, `action-card/highlight`, `text/action`
- Source: Monetization Flow · Help Center

Props of `HelpCenterSheet`:
- `phone / email?`: `string` = +91 9876 543210 / hello@equal.in. Contact rows.
- `onCall / onMail?`: `() => void`. Row taps.

Do: Keep it to the two contact routes.

Don't: Don't send people to a web page from here.

Anatomy:
1. Sheet panel: StatusSheet panel over the scrim, labelled Help Center. (bg/surface · radius 24 top · padding 12/12/20 · content inset 8/8/0)
2. SheetHeading: title: The sheet's title. (title Medium · text/primary · h2 on web, heading() in Compose)
3. SheetHeading: body: One line saying how the team can help. (body1 · text/secondary · 4 above)
4. HelpContactRow: A tappable route to support: Call Us or Mail Us. (radius 14 · 1dp stroke/subtle · padding 12/12/12/16 · gap 12 · 16 above the first, 12 between)
5. HelpContactRow: text: What the route is and the number or address. (title subheading text/primary over value body1 text/secondary)
6. HelpContactRow: icon tile: Green pill with the call or mail icon. (52 × 36 · radius full · action-card/highlight · 22dp icon text/action · decorative)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: Panel is role=dialog (aria-modal in overlay) with an h2; each HelpContactRow is a native button. Android: Panel has paneTitle 'Help Center'; SheetHeading title has heading(); rows are clickable(Role.Button).
- Name. Web: Each row is named by its text, e.g. 'Call Us +91 9876 543210'; the icon has no label. Android: Row text merges into 'Call Us, +91 9876 543210'; the icon has contentDescription null.
- Keyboard. Web: Tab to each row, Enter/Space activates. No Escape, no focus trap, and the scrim has no click handler, so the sheet cannot be closed from inside. Android: TalkBack: jump to the 'Help Center' heading, swipe to the rows, double-tap. The scrim swallows taps and system Back is not handled.
- Touch target. Web: Rows are full width and about 66 px tall. Android: Rows are full width and about 66dp tall.
- Contrast. Web: Title text/primary and value text/secondary (7.5:1) pass. The icon text/action on action-card/highlight is 2.64:1 in light (below 3:1); lime on #2F3423 is 10.7:1 in dark. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: No selected or disabled state; press shows a 0.97 scale (eq-pressable). Android: No state; press shows the ripple.
- Motion. Web: Sheet slides up (motion.slow); off under prefers-reduced-motion. Android: StatusSheet slides up and does not check rememberReduceMotion.

Known accessibility gaps:
- HelpCenterSheet (Monetization.tsx and Monetization.kt) has no way to close from inside: no close button, no scrim tap, no Escape or Back handling.
- HelpContactRow icon (text/action on action-card/highlight) is 2.64:1 in light theme, below 3:1 for icons.
- StatusSheet in Monetization.tsx does not move focus into the dialog or trap it.

Example: Default
```tsx
<HelpCenterSheet phone="+91 9876 543210" email="hello@equal.in" onCall={call} onMail={mail} />
```
```kotlin
HelpCenterSheet(phone = "+91 9876 543210", email = "hello@equal.in", onCall = {}, onMail = {}, inline = true)
```

entries.name: locked-content
entries.title: Locked content
entries.summary: How free users see what Unlimited unlocks: blurred previews with the crown-lock badge, the Unlock All Details card, and the Unlock Audio pill. Each is a paywall touchpoint.
entries.text:
# Locked content (`locked-content`)
Group: Monetization

How free users see what Unlimited unlocks: blurred previews with the crown-lock badge, the Unlock All Details card, and the Unlock Audio pill. Each is a paywall touchpoint.

- React: `import { Locked, LockBadge, UnlockDetailsCard, UnlockAudioPill, ChatListItem, ChatBubble, CallSummary } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `LockedContent`, `LockBadge`, `UnlockDetailsCard`, `UnlockAudioPill`
- Tokens: `locked/badge-bg`, `gradient/status-gold`, `button/primary`
- Source: Monetization Flow · touchpoints

Props of `Locked`:
- `children`: `ReactNode`. Real content, blurred.
- `badge?`: `boolean` = true. Crown-lock badge.
- `inline?`: `boolean`. One line (chat-list previews).

Props of `UnlockDetailsCard`:
- `title / body / cta?`: `string` = Unlock All Details…. Copy.
- `onUnlock?`: `() => void`. Opens the paywall.

Props of `ChatListItem · ChatBubble · CallSummary`:
- `locked?`: `boolean · boolean · 'audio' | 'all'`. Locked state on the existing components.
- `onUnlock?`: `() => void`. CallSummary: Unlock Audio tap.

Do: Blur the real content so the user sees there is something there. Route every locked tap to the paywall with its touchpoint.

Don't: Don't lock the caller's name or the time; only the content. Don't show the crown-lock to paid users.

Anatomy:
1. Locked wrapper: Wraps the real content in place so the layout stays the same while it is hidden. (web span.eq-locked inline-flex · gap 6 · Compose LockedContent Box (Row when inline, full width, gap 6))
2. Blurred content: The real preview, blurred so the user can tell something is there. (blur 4px / Modifier.blur(4.dp) · pointer-events none, user-select none on web · Compose blur needs API 31+)
3. LockBadge: Gold crown with a padlock that marks the item as locked. (crown-lock asset · 18dp (16 inline) · on locked/badge-bg circle, 2dp padding, 6 right / 8 below the corner · inline: no disc)
4. UnlockDetailsCard: header: Paywall card docked over a locked conversation: crown, title and one line. (radius 20 · gradient/status-gold · white rings · padding 16/16/18 · AnimatedCrown 56 · title 22/26 Bold · body body1 text/secondary)
5. UnlockDetailsCard: CTA: Gold button with the lock icon that opens the paywall. (Button gold lg (45 high) · leading lock icon · gradient/cta-gold · white Bold label · 14 above)
6. UnlockAudioPill: Green pill over a locked recording that opens the paywall. (32 high · padding 0 16 · radius full · button/primary · lock 14 + buttonSmall Bold text/on-action · gap 6 · shadow 0 6 16 button/primary 30%)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: Locked is a span: the content is aria-hidden and a visually hidden sentence replaces it; LockBadge is an img. UnlockDetailsCard CTA and UnlockAudioPill are native buttons. Android: LockedContent uses clearAndSetSemantics with one contentDescription; LockBadge is an Image with contentDescription; UnlockAudioPill is clickable(Role.Button); the CTA is EqualButton.
- Name. Web: Locked reads 'Locked. Unlock Equal Unlimited to see this.' then the badge alt 'Locked' again. Buttons use their visible labels, Unlock Details and Unlock Audio. Android: LockedContent reads 'Locked. Unlock Equal Unlimited to see this.' (the badge is cleared inside it). Buttons use their visible labels.
- Keyboard. Web: Locked itself is not focusable; the parent row or bubble, or the Unlock buttons, take Tab and Enter/Space. Android: TalkBack: swipe to the locked block, which reads as one item; double-tap Unlock Details or Unlock Audio to open the paywall.
- Touch target. Web: UnlockAudioPill is 32 px tall with no eq-touch, so the hit area is 32 px; the lg CTA is 45 px. Both should be at least 48 px. Android: UnlockAudioPill uses minimumInteractiveComponentSize (48dp); EqualButton also enforces 48dp.
- Contrast. Web: UnlockAudioPill: white on button/primary #00B140 is 2.85:1 in light (fails 4.5:1); in dark it is black on lime #BAFF29, 17:1. Card title text/primary and body text/secondary (7.5:1) pass; the gold CTA's white label runs 6.2:1 down to 3.1:1 across gradient/cta-gold. Android: Same tokens as web: the pill's white on green is 2.85:1 in light and fails; dark is black on lime. Gold-on-light card text passes.
- State. Web: Locked is shown by blur plus the crown badge and spoken as text, so it never relies on blur alone. Android: Locked is spoken as text and marked by the badge. Below API 31 the blur is a no-op, so the content is drawn readable.
- Motion. Web: AnimatedCrown sways (4.8s loop) and the gold CTA has a sheen and glow; all stop under prefers-reduced-motion. Android: AnimatedCrown and the gold CTA sheen/glow are static when rememberReduceMotion() is true (animator duration scale 0).

Known accessibility gaps:
- Locked in Monetization.tsx renders LockBadge with alt 'Locked' after the sr-only sentence, so screen readers hear 'Locked' twice; the badge should be decorative (alt='') inside Locked.
- UnlockAudioPill in Monetization.tsx/.css is 32 px tall with no eq-touch, below the 48 px target.
- UnlockAudioPill (Monetization.tsx and Monetization.kt) puts white text on button/primary #00B140, 2.85:1 in light theme; fails 4.5:1.
- Button size lg (Button.css, used by UnlockDetailsCard) is 45 px tall with no touch extension on web.
- LockedContent in Monetization.kt: Modifier.blur is a no-op below API 31, so locked content is readable on older Android.

Example: Locked chat rows
```tsx
<ChatListItem name="Vijay CA" preview="Your KYC is pending" date="1 May"
  avatar={{ category: 'financial' }} locked onClick={openPaywall} />
```
```kotlin
Column {
    ChatListItem(name = "Amit Nanda", preview = "Amit is done with onboarding.", date = "Yesterday",
        category = EqualCategory.Career)
    ChatListItem(name = "Vijay CA", preview = "Your KYC is pending", date = "1 May",
        category = EqualCategory.Financial, locked = true, onClick = { /* open paywall */ })
    ChatListItem(name = "Vijay OLA", preview = "On the gate, need approval.", date = "1 Jul",
        category = EqualCategory.Ride, locked = true, onClick = { /* open paywall */ })
}
```

Example: Locked bubbles and audio
```tsx
<ChatBubble kind="incoming" locked>…</ChatBubble>
<CallSummary summary="…" locked="audio" onUnlock={openPaywall} />
```
```kotlin
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    ChatBubble(type = ChatBubbleType.Outgoing, timestamp = "03:21", message = "Hello, who is this?", locked = true)
    ChatBubble(type = ChatBubbleType.Incoming, incomingCategory = EqualCategory.RealEstate, timestamp = "03:21",
        message = "We have a 2BHK in Sector 12 with good offer", locked = true)
    CallSummaryBubble(
        summary = "Hey Keshav! Here is the summary of your call.",
        timestamp = "03:22",
        locked = CallSummaryLock.Audio,
        onUnlock = { /* open paywall */ },
        voiceNote = {
            VoiceNotePlayer(isPlaying = false, onPlayPauseClick = {}, progress = 0f, elapsed = "0:00",
                total = "2:37", speed = PlaybackSpeed.X1, onSpeedChange = {})
        },
    )
}
```

Example: Unlock All Details
```tsx
<UnlockDetailsCard onUnlock={openPaywall} />
```
```kotlin
UnlockDetailsCard(onUnlock = { /* open paywall */ })
```

Example: Badge and wrapper
```tsx
<LockBadge />
<Locked><Text variant="body1">…</Text></Locked>
<UnlockAudioPill onClick={openPaywall} />
```
```kotlin
Row(horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(24.dp), verticalAlignment = Alignment.CenterVertically) {
    LockBadge()
    LockedContent {
        EqualText(text = "Hey this is vijay calling from magicbrick", style = EqualTheme.type.body1,
            color = EqualTheme.colors.textPrimary)
    }
    UnlockAudioPill(onClick = { /* open paywall */ })
}
```

entries.text:
# Payment status (`payment-status`)
Group: Monetization

The result sheets after the user pays: Waiting for Confirmation, Payment Confirmed, Pending, Failed and Congratulations. All share the ring StatusCard.

- React: `import { PaymentStatusSheet, StatusCard, StatusSheet, RedirectNote } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `PaymentStatusSheet`, `StatusCard`, `StatusSheet`, `RedirectNote`
- Tokens: `gradient/status-neutral`, `gradient/status-success`, `gradient/status-warning`, `gradient/status-danger`, `gradient/status-gold`, `scrim`
- Source: Monetization Flow · payment results

Props of `PaymentStatusSheet`:
- `status`: `'waiting' | 'confirmed' | 'pending' | 'failed' | 'welcome'`. Result.
- `cardLast4?`: `string` = '2652'. In the refund line.
- `onRetry / onContactSupport / onRedirect?`: `() => void`. Actions.
- `waitingArt?`: `'status-waiting' | 'status-waiting-cash'` = 'status-waiting'. Experiment: coin or cash art.
- `mode?`: `'overlay' | 'inline'` = 'overlay'. Inline for docs.

Props of `StatusCard`:
- `tone`: `'neutral' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger' | 'gold'`. Tint.
- `art`: `AssetName`. 3D art (100dp).
- `strong`: `string`. Bold line 28/32.
- `light?`: `string`. Regular line 22/26.
- `strongFirst?`: `boolean` = true. Order of the lines.

Do: Say what happens to the money on pending and failed. Auto-redirect after success, with the countdown visible.

Don't: Don't add a close button; each result has one next step.

Anatomy:
1. Sheet panel: StatusSheet: the panel over a dimmed screen that holds the result; it has no close button. (scrim token · bg/surface · radius 24 top (24 all round inline) · padding 12/12/20 · shadow 0 -8 30 black 12%)
2. StatusCard container: Tinted ring card that carries the result. (radius 20 · 1dp stroke/subtle · gradient/status-neutral|success|warning|danger|gold · padding 18/16 · white rings (20% in dark))
3. Sunburst: Slowly turning ray burst behind the art on success and welcome. (24 rays · sunburst/ray · centred 70 down · radius 280 · one turn per motion.reward · decorative)
4. Art: 3D result art. (100dp · status-waiting / status-waiting-cash, status-confirmed, status-pending, status-failed · AnimatedCrown 100 for welcome · decorative)
5. Title lines: Two display lines that name the result. (strong 28/32 Bold -0.02em · light 22/26 Regular · text/primary · order from strongFirst · 10 below art)
6. Body: One line on what happens next or to the money. (body1 text/secondary · 8 above · refund line names card **2652)
7. Footer: The single next step. (padding 16 top, 8 sides · RedirectNote body2 text/action, or block lg primary button Contact Support / Retry Payment)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: StatusSheet panel is role=dialog, aria-modal in overlay mode; the title lines are divs, not headings; RedirectNote has aria-live=polite. Android: Panel sets paneTitle; RedirectNote has liveRegion Polite; art and Sunburst carry no semantics.
- Name. Web: aria-label is built as strong + light, so Waiting reads 'Confirmation Waiting for'. It should follow the visual order: 'Waiting for Confirmation', 'Payment Confirmed'. Android: paneTitle is built as light + strong, so Confirmed reads 'Confirmed Payment'. It should follow strongFirst.
- Keyboard. Web: Focus is not moved into the dialog or trapped; Tab reaches the footer button and Enter/Space activates it. There is no close, so Escape does nothing by design. Android: TalkBack: swipe through title, body and footer; double-tap Contact Support or Retry Payment. The component does not handle system Back.
- Touch target. Web: Footer Button lg is 45 px tall with no touch extension; it should be 48 px. Android: EqualButton Block enforces a 48dp minimum.
- Contrast. Web: Titles text/primary and body text/secondary (7.5:1) pass on the tints. Footer buttons: white on button/primary #00B140 is 2.85:1 in light (fails 4.5:1); in dark it is black on lime #BAFF29, 17:1. RedirectNote text/action on bg/surface is 2.85:1 in light, lime 13:1 in dark. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: The result is said in words and art as well as tint. Waiting steps (Connecting To Razorpay, Verifying Transaction) change every 1.4s with no live region. RedirectNote announces every one-second tick. Android: Waiting steps change the paneTitle; the card has no live region. RedirectNote's live region announces every tick.
- Motion. Web: Sheet slides up, each title rises in, Sunburst turns and the crown sways; all stop under prefers-reduced-motion. Android: Title rise, Sunburst and crown check rememberReduceMotion(); the StatusSheet slide-up does not.

Known accessibility gaps:
- PaymentStatusSheet in Monetization.tsx names the dialog strong + light ('Confirmation Waiting for'); Monetization.kt uses light + strong ('Confirmed Payment'). Both should follow strongFirst.
- RedirectNote (Monetization.tsx and Monetization.kt) is a polite live region updated every second, so the countdown is announced five times; announce once.
- Waiting progress steps in PaymentStatusSheet (Monetization.tsx) change the title with no live region, so screen-reader users miss them.
- StatusSheet in Monetization.tsx is role=dialog but does not move focus into the panel or trap it.
- StatusSheet in Monetization.kt always plays the slide-up; it does not check rememberReduceMotion like the other sheets.
- Contact Support / Retry Payment (white on button/primary) and RedirectNote (text/action on white) are 2.85:1 in light theme.
- Footer Button lg (Button.css) is 45 px tall on web with no touch extension.

Example: Waiting for Confirmation (Compose)
```kotlin
PaymentStatusSheet(status = PaymentStatus.Waiting, inline = true)
```

Example: Payment Confirmed (Compose)
```kotlin
PaymentStatusSheet(status = PaymentStatus.Confirmed, onRedirect = { /* go home */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Payment Pending (Compose)
```kotlin
PaymentStatusSheet(status = PaymentStatus.Pending, onContactSupport = { /* open HelpCenterSheet */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Payment Failed (Compose)
```kotlin
PaymentStatusSheet(status = PaymentStatus.Failed, onRetry = { /* retry payment */ }, inline = true)
```

Example: Congratulations (Compose)
```kotlin
PaymentStatusSheet(status = PaymentStatus.Welcome, onRedirect = { /* go home */ }, inline = true)
```

entries.text:
# Paywall (`paywall`)
Group: Monetization

The Equal Unlimited paywall: gold hero with the 3D crown, the price, a preview of what is locked (it changes with the touchpoint), and the sticky gold CTA.

- React: `import { PaywallHero, PriceTag, LockedPreviewCard, PaywallFooter, AnimatedCrown } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `PaywallHero`, `PriceTag`, `LockedPreviewCard`, `PaywallFooter`, `AnimatedCrown`
- Tokens: `gradient/paywall-hero`, `gradient/gold-text`, `gradient/cta-gold`, `text/gold`, `paywall/card-bg`, `paywall/card-stroke`, `paywall/divider`
- Source: Monetization Flow · Unlock Equal Unlimited

Props of `PaywallHero`:
- `title?`: `string` = 'Unlock Equal'. Regular first line.
- `titleStrong?`: `string` = 'Unlimited'. Bold display line.
- `subtitle?`: `ReactNode` = Unlock Summaries…. Experiment: copy variant.
- `onBack / onSupport?`: `() => void`. Header actions; Support opens the Help Center sheet.
- `children?`: `ReactNode`. Price, preview, coupon.

Props of `PriceTag`:
- `price`: `number | string`. Shown price (drops when the coupon applies).
- `label?`: `string | null` = 'Limited time discount'. Gold caps label with 🎊.
- `currency?`: `string` = '₹'. Prefix.

Props of `PaywallFooter`:
- `cta?`: `string` = 'Unlock Unlimited'. Gold block button.
- `note?`: `string | null` = 'Cancel Anytime. Automatically renews'. Caption under it.
- `onClick?`: `() => void`. Starts payment.
- `variant?`: `'gold' | 'gold-outline' | 'primary'` = 'gold'. gold-outline for Cancel Subscription on the plan page.
- `disabled?`: `boolean`. While a payment is processing.
- `flat?`: `boolean`. No surface or shadow, inside the sheet paywall.
- `above?`: `ReactNode`. Above the button, e.g. the processing toast.

Do: Pick the preview from the touchpoint the user came from. Keep one gold CTA; it is the only commit on the page.

Don't: Don't use a serif for the display lines; the system is DM Sans only. Don't hide the auto-renew note.

Anatomy:
1. Hero: Gold gradient with soft rings. (gradient/paywall-hero · rings every 70 from r 47 · padding-bottom 8)
2. Top bar: Back and Support. (56 high · padding 0 12 0 4 · IconButton arrow-back · help-circle 20 + body2)
3. AnimatedCrown: 3D gold crown with a slow sway. (64 · 4.8 s turntable sway ±20° · drop shadow)
4. Titles: "Unlock Equal" over "Unlimited". (22/26 Regular · 38/42 Bold −0.03em · text/primary)
5. Subtitle: What Unlimited unlocks. (body1 · text/secondary · max width 300 · centred)
6. PriceTag: Discount label and the big gold price. (caption text/gold 🎊 · price 44/48 gradient/gold-text · paywall/divider hairlines)
7. LockedPreviewCard: Cream frame around a preview of what is locked. (radius 20 · paywall/card-bg · 1 px paywall/card-stroke · padding 8 · inner radius 14 bg/surface)
8. PaywallFooter: Sticky gold CTA and the renew note. (bg/surface · shadow 0 -6 18 · padding 12 16 16 · Button lg block 45 · gradient/cta-gold · caption text/secondary)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: Hero is a <section>; "Unlimited" is the <h1> ("Unlock Equal" is a div); Back is an IconButton, Support and CTA are <button>s; crown is alt="". Android: Back PlainIconButton, Support Row Role.Button, CTA EqualButton Role.Button; no heading() on the titles; crown has no contentDescription.
- Name. Web: Back aria-label "Back"; Support and CTA from their text; 🎊 is aria-hidden. Android: Back "Back"; "Unlimited" has contentDescription "Unlock Equal Unlimited" so the first line is read twice; was-price reads "was ₹249 /Monthly".
- Keyboard. Web: Tab: Back, Support, the preview content, coupon, CTA. Rows inside PaywallPreview are role=button and focusable even though they are only a preview. Android: TalkBack: swipe through bar, titles, price, preview, CTA.
- Touch target. Web: Back 40 px and Support use eq-touch (48); CTA is 45 px high, full width. Android: Back 48 dp; Support minimumInteractiveComponentSize; CTA EqualButton (≥ 48 dp).
- Contrast. Web: Titles text/primary on gold 14:1; subtitle 6.5:1. Price gradient top #B57E32 is about 3:1 on the hero (passes only as large text). CTA white on gold is 6.2:1 → 3.1:1 left to right, about 4.6:1 at the centre. Android: Same tokens; dark gold text 10:1.
- State. Web: Footer disabled uses the native disabled attribute while a payment processes. The struck list price is an <s> with no spoken "was". Android: EqualButton enabled = false; was-price has a "was" contentDescription.
- Motion. Web: Crown sway, gold CTA sheen and glow, and price-drop animations stop under prefers-reduced-motion; the price phase timers still swap the value after 800 ms. Android: Crown, sheen, glow and price drop all hold still when rememberReduceMotion() is true.

Known accessibility gaps:
- Only "Unlimited" is the h1; "Unlock Equal" sits outside the heading (Monetization.tsx PaywallHero).
- PaywallPreview rows (ChatListItem role=button tabIndex=0) are focusable inside a non-interactive preview; mark the preview inert or aria-hidden with a text summary (MonetizationScreens.tsx).
- PriceTag list price is an <s> with no "was" text for screen readers (Monetization.tsx).
- Compose titles: contentDescription "Unlock Equal Unlimited" on titleStrong makes TalkBack read "Unlock Equal" twice, and neither line is a heading() (Monetization.kt PaywallHero).
- Compose PriceTag 🎊 EmojiGlyphs are read aloud by TalkBack (Monetization.kt).

Example: Hero with price and preview
```tsx
<PaywallHero onBack={back} onSupport={openHelp}>
  <PriceTag price={249} />
  <LockedPreviewCard>…what's locked…</LockedPreviewCard>
</PaywallHero>
```
```kotlin
PaywallHero(onBack = {}, onSupport = { /* open HelpCenterSheet */ }) {
    PriceTag(price = "249")
    LockedPreviewCard {
        Column {
            ChatListItem(name = "HDFC RM", preview = "Loan pre-approval request", date = "1:00 PM",
                category = EqualCategory.GateAlert)
            EqualDivider()
            ChatListItem(name = "Vijay NoBroker", preview = "About miniature painting", date = "Yesterday",
                category = EqualCategory.RealEstate, locked = true)
        }
    }
}
```

Example: Preview by touchpoint
```tsx
<PaywallPreview touchpoint="chat-list" />
<PaywallPreview touchpoint="chat" />
<PaywallPreview touchpoint="audio" />
```
```kotlin
Column(verticalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
    // Chat list
    LockedPreviewCard {
        ChatListItem(name = "Vijay NoBroker", preview = "About miniature painting", date = "Yesterday",
            category = EqualCategory.RealEstate, locked = true)
    }
    // Chat
    LockedPreviewCard {
        Column(Modifier.padding(horizontal = 4.dp, vertical = 12.dp)) {
            ChatBubble(type = ChatBubbleType.Outgoing, timestamp = "03:21", message = "Hello, who is this?")
            ChatBubble(type = ChatBubbleType.Incoming, incomingCategory = EqualCategory.RealEstate,
                timestamp = "03:21", message = "Vijay from no broker", modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 12.dp))
            ChatBubble(type = ChatBubbleType.Incoming, incomingCategory = EqualCategory.RealEstate,
                isFirstInGroup = false, timestamp = "03:21", locked = true, modifier = Modifier.padding(top = 4.dp),
                message = "Hey this is vijay calling from magicbrick a property advisor")
        }
    }
    // Audio
    LockedPreviewCard {
        CallSummaryBubble(
            summary = "Hey Keshav! Here is the summary of your call.",
            timestamp = "03:21",
            locked = CallSummaryLock.Audio,
            onUnlock = { /* open paywall */ },
            voiceNote = {
                VoiceNotePlayer(isPlaying = false, onPlayPauseClick = {}, progress = 0f, elapsed = "0:00",
                    total = "2:37", speed = PlaybackSpeed.X1, onSpeedChange = {})
            },
            modifier = Modifier.padding(4.dp),
        )
    }
}
```

Example: Animated crown
```tsx
<AnimatedCrown size={64} />
<AnimatedCrown size={64} animated={false} />
```
```kotlin
// Turntable sway (4.8s loop); static when animations are off. Stands in for the crown video.
AnimatedCrown(size = 64.dp)
```

Example: Sticky footer
```tsx
<PaywallFooter cta="Unlock Unlimited" note="Cancel Anytime. Automatically renews" onClick={buy} />
```
```kotlin
PaywallFooter(
    onClick = { /* start payment */ },
    cta = "Unlock Unlimited",
    note = "Cancel Anytime. Automatically renews",
)
```

entries.name: monetization-experiments
entries.title: Paywall experiments
entries.summary: The pieces the Android team A/B tests around the paywall: full-screen payment results, the processing strip, the sheet paywall with its coupon row, Help Center and exit offer, the offer strip, home notice and usage cards, Equal AI’s own notice, crown-locked actions and recordings
entries.text:
# Paywall experiments (`monetization-experiments`)
Group: Monetization

The pieces the Android team A/B tests around the paywall: full-screen payment results, the processing strip, the sheet paywall with its coupon row, Help Center and exit offer, the offer strip, home notice and usage cards, Equal AI’s own notice, crown-locked actions and recordings.

- React: `import { PaymentResult, ProcessingStrip, PaywallSheet, CouponRow, HelpFaqSheet, ExitOfferDialog, OfferStrip, HomeNoticeCard, UsageCapCard, AssistantNoticeCard, SummaryActions, LockedRecording } from '@equal/ds';`
- Compose: `PaymentResult`, `ProcessingStrip`, `PaywallSheet`, `CouponRow`, `HelpFaqSheet`, `ExitOfferDialog`, `OfferStrip`, `HomeNoticeCard`, `UsageCapCard`, `AssistantNoticeCard`, `SummaryActions`, `LockedRecording`
- Tokens: `gradient/result-success`, `gradient/result-pending`, `gradient/result-failed`, `result/ring`, `processing/bg`, `processing/ring`, `offer-strip/bg`, `plan-badge/expired-bg`
- Source: All Payment States · Payment Pending · Home / Conversation Screen (light & dark) · Plan Expired & Usage Cap touchpoints · Recordings + Transcripts Locked · Actions on Home Page

Props of `PaymentResult`:
- `status`: `'success' | 'pending' | 'failed'`. Which page.
- `activeTill?`: `string` = '10th Sept 2026'. Success date.
- `pendingAction?`: `'refresh' | 'support'` = 'refresh'. Pending CTA.
- `header?`: `ReactNode`. Status bar on the wash.

Props of `PaywallSheet`:
- `price?`: `number` = 249. List price.
- `discountedPrice?`: `number` = 149. With EQUAL25.
- `applied?`: `boolean`. Coupon applied.
- `processing?`: `boolean`. Toast + disabled CTA.
- `cta?`: `string` = 'Unlock Equal AI Unlimited'. CTA copy (experiment).
- `mode?`: `'overlay' | 'inline'` = 'overlay'. Docs: inline.

Props of `ExitOfferDialog`:
- `dismissLabel?`: `string` = 'Not Now'. Leave in chats.
- `claimLabel?`: `string` = 'Claim 25% Off'. Keep 25% Off in chats.

Props of `ProcessingStrip`:
- `variant?`: `'strip' | 'card' | 'toast'` = 'strip'. Where it sits.

Do: Pass experiments as props on the same screen (Home, Chat, Paywall); never fork a screen per variant. While a payment is processing, show it everywhere it matters and disable the paywall CTA.

Don't: Don't show the exit offer more than once per session. Don't lock the caller's name, the time or the summary label; only content and actions.

Anatomy:
1. PaymentResult: Full-screen payment result with a tinted wash. (gradient/result-success|pending|failed · result/ring rings · 36/44 close or back chip · 84 art · title 30/36 Bold (h1) · body body1 text/secondary · block lg action pinned at the bottom)
2. ProcessingStrip: Payment processing notice with a spinning ring. (processing/bg · padding 8/12 · gap 10 · 30 ring, 3dp processing/ring arc around an 18 info dot · title body2 Medium + caption text/secondary · strip / card radius 12 / toast)
3. PaywallSheet card: Compact gold paywall in a bottom sheet. (bg/surface panel radius 28 top · card radius 20 gradient/paywall-hero, 1dp paywall/card-stroke · Support top-right · crown 56 · 'Unlimited' 34/38 Bold · price 34/40 gold)
4. CouponRow: EQUAL25 coupon with APPLY / APPLIED. (radius 14 · gradient/coupon · 1dp paywall/card-stroke · padding 10/14 · code subheading Bold text/gold · APPLY body2 Bold text/gold)
5. ExitOfferDialog + OfferStrip: Exit offer card and the home strip after declining. (dialog radius 20, bg/surface, padding 18/16/16, black 55% scrim, gold-outline + gold md buttons · strip offer-strip/bg, offer-strip/text, underlined Claim Now)
6. HomeNoticeCard / UsageCapCard: Home card with a CTA and optional usage bar. (radius 16 · bg/surface · 1dp stroke/subtle · padding 12/14 · title subheading + caption · md primary button · 6dp bar stroke/subtle track, button/primary fill)
7. AssistantNoticeCard: Equal AI's own message with a voice note and CTA. (radius 16 · bg/surface · voice player · 'Equal AI' body2 text/action · title subheading · 48 CTA row with crown-lock, text/action)
8. SummaryActions + LockedRecording: Locked actions and recording on the free plan. (48 rows, 1dp stroke/subtle top · locked: crown-lock 16 + text/gold · recording blurred 2.5 on gold wash · 40 gold badge with crown-lock 26)

Accessibility:
- Role. Web: PaymentResult is a section with aria-label and an h1; ProcessingStrip is role=status; PaywallSheet and HelpFaqSheet are role=dialog; ExitOfferDialog is role=alertdialog; OfferStrip is role=status; usage bar is role=progressbar; LockedRecording is a button. Android: PaymentResult, PaywallSheet, HelpFaqSheet and ExitOfferDialog set paneTitle; ProcessingStrip merges with liveRegion Polite; price and APPLIED are live regions; LockedRecording is Role.Button with one description.
- Name. Web: Chips 'Close' / 'Back'; LockedRecording 'Recording locked. Unlock Equal AI Unlimited'; locked actions read 'Locked Call Back'; buttons by text. The usage bar has no label. Android: Same strings; usage bar reads 'N% used'; locked crown 'Locked'.
- Keyboard. Web: Tab through actions; Enter/Space activate. Sheets and dialogs don't move or trap focus and ignore Escape; scrim clicks call onScrim. Android: TalkBack: swipe and double-tap; scrims have onClickLabel 'Close'. System Back is not handled.
- Touch target. Web: Result chips 36 with eq-touch (48); APPLY, Support and Claim Now use eq-touch; ExitOfferDialog and HomeNoticeCard md buttons are 36 px and lg buttons 45 px with no extension. Android: EqualButton and APPLY/Support/Claim Now meet 48dp; the PaymentResult close/back chip is 44dp with no minimum size.
- Contrast. Web: Primary buttons are white on green 2.85:1 in light; text/action CTAs and labels on white 2.85:1. Offer strip 9.2:1 light / 9.0:1 dark; processing text primary, ring gold 5.3:1; locked gold labels 6:1 on white; gold CTAs white 6.2→3.1:1. Android: Same tokens and ratios as web.
- State. Web: Processing is announced (role=status) and disables the CTA (disabled attribute). Locked actions show the crown and gold label plus 'Locked' in the name. APPLIED on CouponRow is plain text with no live region. Android: Processing is a live region and the CTA is disabled; APPLIED and the new price are polite live regions.
- Motion. Web: Sheet slide-up, exit-offer spring, processing ring spin, price land, crown and gold CTA sheen; all stop under prefers-reduced-motion. Android: SheetLayer, exit spring, ring spin and price land check rememberReduceMotion.

Known accessibility gaps:
- CouponRow in MonetizationExperiments.tsx swaps APPLY for APPLIED with no live region (Compose announces it).
- HomeNoticeCard usage bar in MonetizationExperiments.tsx is role=progressbar with no accessible name.
- ExitOfferDialog (alertdialog), PaywallSheet and HelpFaqSheet in MonetizationExperiments.tsx don't move or trap focus or close on Escape.
- ExitOfferDialog and HomeNoticeCard md buttons (36 px) and lg buttons (45 px) have no touch extension on web.
- PaymentResult close/back chip in MonetizationExperiments.kt is 44dp with no minimumInteractiveComponentSize.
- Primary buttons and text/action labels (Refresh Status, Retry payment, AssistantNoticeCard CTA, unlocked SummaryActions) are 2.85:1 in light theme.

Example: Payment results

```kotlin
Row(Modifier.height(440.dp), horizontalArrangement = Arrangement.spacedBy(12.dp)) {
```

```tsx
<ProcessingStrip />                 // under a chat header
```

```kotlin
// Over a screen: draw it last in a full-size Box (onScrim → the exit offer). Docs: inline = true.
PaywallSheet(
    applied = applied,
    onApply = { applied = true },
    onSupport = { /* HelpFaqSheet */ },
```

Example: Exit offer and offer strip

```kotlin
    ExitOfferDialog(onDismiss = {}, onClaim = {}, inline = true, modifier = Modifier.padding(horizontal = 16.dp))
```

Example: Home cards

```tsx
<UsageCapCard left={7} limit={30} resets="Mon" onUpgrade={openPaywall} />
```

```kotlin
        title = "Your Plan Expired",

    )
```

Example: Equal AI notice
```tsx
<AssistantNoticeCard title="Your Plan Expired" body="Renew to unlock unlimited recordings, …" cta="Renew Equal AI Unlimited" onCta={openPaywall} />
```

```kotlin
AssistantNoticeCard(
    title = "Your Plan Expired",
    body = "Renew to unlock unlimited recordings, call summaries, transcripts, and unlimited call screening.",
    cta = "Renew Equal AI Unlimited",
    onCta = { /* open the paywall */ },

```

Example: Locked recording and actions

```tsx
<LockedRecording onUnlock={openPaywall} />
<SummaryActions locked actions={[{ label: 'Call Back', icon: 'call-filled' }, { label: 'Add to Calendar', icon: 'calendar' }]} onLocked={openPaywall} />
<SmallActionChip label="Call Back" emoji="📞" locked />   // ChatListItem lockedActions
```
