entries.text:
# Flow: Global MYA (`/flows/global-mya`)

Tap the green orb anywhere and your assistant answers in a sheet: a greeting, quick actions and suggestions, then a request typed or spoken. The request turns into a short task conversation that ends with the result to confirm.

Source: Global MYA

1. Open: the green orb (the nav FAB) opens the sheet over whatever screen you’re on: orb, “Good morning, Keshav” (name in green), “What can I help you with today?”, three quick-action tiles, suggestion chips, and a message field with the mic.
2. Type: focusing the field hides the tiles and lifts the input above the keyboard (green outline). Enter sends.
3. Speak: the mic swaps the field for Send voice note with a keyboard toggle. Tap it to record: “Try saying …”, then delete, the timer with a live waveform, and send. Or press and hold: “Release to send, slide left to cancel”, and sliding left turns the waveform red (“Release to cancel”).
4. Task: once sent, the sheet grows into a conversation titled with what the assistant is doing (“Setting up a reminder…”), with close. Your voice note (player + transcript) → Thinking… → the result card (here a WhatsApp reminder) with Edit / Confirm.
5. Inside a chat: the chat’s own AI layer (“Want me to send Amit a quick reply on WhatsApp?”) works the same way. Tapping a chip or sending a message raises the task sheet, which stops below the chat header so you can still see whose chat it is. “Replying Amit on WhatsApp” shows the drafted reply with ✏️ Edit / 📤 Send and the 📤 Send · ✏️ Edit draft · 🖋️ Custom chips. Confirming shows “Opening WhatsApp…” and greys the chips out.
6. Done: Confirm ticks the card, the sheet closes, and the chat it acted on now reads “Reminder added”. Saved contacts carry the person badge on their initials.

States:
- `home` Home (Try it: tap the orb): `<HomeScreen chats={chats} promo="meet-assistant-carousel" />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      // Home: tap the green orb (nav FAB) to open the live sheet
      HomeScreenSample(chats = MyaSampleChats, promo = { MeetAssistantCarousel(onDismiss = {}) })
  }
  ```
- `greeting` Greeting & quick actions: `<HomeScreen chats={chats} assistantResult={{ chatId: 'c3', preview: 'Reminder added' }} />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      HomeScreenSample(chats = MyaSampleChats, promo = { MeetAssistantCarousel(onDismiss = {}) }, assistant = MyaStage.Greeting)
  }
  ```
- `chat-ai` In a chat: the AI layer (Try it): `<ChatScreen chat={amit} />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      // Tap Reply on WhatsApp (or send a message) to open the task sheet
      ChatScreenSample(name = "Amit Nanda", initials = "AN", category = EqualCategory.NA, subtitle = "+91 98717 46113")
  }
  ```
- `chat-task` In a chat: Replying Amit on WhatsApp: `<ChatScreen chat={amit} aiTask="draft" />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      ChatScreenSample(name = "Amit Nanda", initials = "AN", category = EqualCategory.NA, subtitle = "+91 98717 46113", aiTask = ChatTaskStage.Draft)
  }
  ```
- `chat-sending` In a chat: Opening WhatsApp: `<ChatScreen chat={amit} aiTask="sending" />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      ChatScreenSample(name = "Amit Nanda", initials = "AN", category = EqualCategory.NA, subtitle = "+91 98717 46113", aiTask = ChatTaskStage.Sending)
  }
  ```

entries.text:
# Flow: Known-call notifications (`/flows/known-calls`)

When the assistant answers someone you know, Android shows an ongoing notification that tells you who it is and what they want, with quick replies, and hands the call to you when it needs you. Opening it shows the live chat.

Source: Known-call notifications

1. Answering: “Equal AI • Ongoing” with a live timer; the caller (their avatar) and “Your Equal AI is answering your call.”, with the Equal app badge.
2. Summary: the line updates to what the caller wants as the call goes on.
3. Expanded: two lines, a call button to pick up, and quick replies: Takeover first, then suggested answers the assistant can say for you.
4. Hand-off: when it needs you, the replies give way to “This needs your attention, connecting this call to you”.
5. Open: the chat shows the call live under a black Ongoing call - 02:34 strip with Takeover in the header and the assistant’s follow-up below. Android draws the notification shell; the system wallpaper here is a coded stand-in.

States:
- `answering` Answering: `<CallNotification name="Mom" state="answering" />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      CallNotification(name = "Mom", state = CallNotificationState.Answering)
  }
  ```
- `summary` What they want: `<CallNotification name="Mom" state="summary" summary={liveSummary} />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      CallNotification(name = "Mom", state = CallNotificationState.Summary, summary = SampleCallSummary)
  }
  ```
- `expanded` Expanded: quick replies: `<CallNotification name="Mom" state="expanded" replies={["Takeover", "I’ll bring them all", "I’ll call back to get more"]} onReply={reply} onAnswer={answer} />`
  ```kotlin

      CallNotification(
          name = "Mom",
          state = CallNotificationState.Expanded,
          replies = listOf("Takeover", "I’ll bring them all", "I’ll call back to get more"),
          onReply = { /* say it (it == "Takeover": pick up) */ },
          onAnswer = { /* pick up */ },
      )
  }
  ```
- `connecting` Needs you: connecting: `<CallNotification name="Mom" state="connecting" />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      // Docs: on the coded wallpaper. On device the system draws the shade.
      KnownCallNotificationScreen(state = CallNotificationState.Connecting)
  }
  ```
- `chat` Live chat: `<ChatScreen chat={mom} live ongoing="02:34" />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      ChatScreenSample(
          name = "Mom",
          category = EqualCategory.HomeServices,
          live = true,
          ongoing = "02:34",
          onTakeover = { /* pick up */ },
      )
  }
  ```

entries.text:
# Flow: Error states (`/flows/error-states`)

How the AI layer fails: say what happened in one line and offer the one action that fixes it.

Source: Error states

1. Generation failure: “Sorry, I couldn’t do that just now. Please try again.” with 🔄 Retry, inside the task.
2. Offline in a task: “It looks like you’re offline. Try again once you’re back online.” with 🔄 Retry.
3. Voice input failure: the AI layer asks again: “Sorry, I didn’t catch that. Could you hold and speak again?”
4. Offline sheet: over the chat, the struck wifi, “No internet connection” and Refresh. Full screen: the same with Try again, when there is nothing to show yet.

States:
- `generation` Generation failure: `<ChatErrorScreen state="generation" onRetry={retry} />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      ChatErrorScreen(state = ErrorState.Generation, onRetry = { /* retry */ })
  }
  ```
- `offline-reply` No internet (in a task): `<ChatErrorScreen state="offline-reply" onRetry={retry} />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      ChatErrorScreen(state = ErrorState.OfflineReply, onRetry = { /* retry */ })
  }
  ```
- `voice` Voice input failure: `<ChatErrorScreen state="voice" />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      ChatErrorScreen(state = ErrorState.Voice)
  }
  ```
- `offline-sheet` No internet (sheet): `<ChatErrorScreen state="offline-sheet" onRetry={refresh} />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      ChatErrorScreen(state = ErrorState.OfflineSheet, onRetry = { /* refresh */ })
  }
  ```
- `offline-screen` No internet (full screen): `<ChatErrorScreen state="offline-screen" onRetry={retry} />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      ChatErrorScreen(state = ErrorState.OfflineScreen, onRetry = { /* retry */ })
  }
  ```

# Flow: Contact info (`/flows/contact-info`)

The caller’s page: category avatar, name and number, four action tiles and the call history.

Source: Contact Info

1. Header: a 96dp category avatar (or initials for saved contacts), the headline name and a tabular phone number.
2. Actions: Call, Mute (toggles to Unmute), Save and Share as 72dp tiles with the icon in text/action.
3. Call history: phone_callback, phone_missed (red icon, label not red) and phone_forwarded rows inside a card.

States:
- `contact` Contact Info: `<ContactInfoScreen onBack={goBack} />`
  ```kotlin
  EqualTheme {
      ContactInfoScreen(name = "Amit Nanda", phone = "+91 9871746113", onBack = {})
  }
  ```

# Image assets

Web `<Asset name="…" size={dp} />`, Compose `EqualAssetImage(EqualAssets.<PascalName>, size)`. "needed" means only a placeholder ships today; ask the designer for it.

- `mascot-robot`: Robot mascot — AI Assistant card on Chats (40dp, via <Mascot>)
- `avatar-male`: Profile avatar (male): You tab header + bottom-nav "You"
- `avatar-female`: Profile avatar (female): You tab header + bottom-nav "You"
- `illustration-high-five`: Invite a Friend card: 113 × 112, flush left, 29dp above the card (tilt baked into the file)
- `illustration-trash`: Delete confirm sheet (72dp)
- `logo-orb-light`: Equal orb, light mode (#00B140): AI avatar, FAB
- `logo-orb-dark`: Equal orb, dark mode (lime): AI avatar, FAB
- `illustration-silent-mode`: Silent Mode header (3D bell + phone, 160dp)
- `illustration-whatsapp`: WhatsApp Updates header + turn-off sheet (3D WhatsApp phone, 160 / 120dp)
- `illustration-addresses-empty`: Addresses empty state (robot on a map, 200dp)
- `illustration-instructions-empty`: Active Instructions empty state (robot on a book, 200dp)
- `illustration-suggestions`: "New suggestions coming…" card (robot with call bubbles, 120dp)
- `avatar-male-bust`: Gender card, male (bust without the ring). Falls back to avatar-male
- `avatar-female-bust`: Gender card, female (bust without the ring). Falls back to avatar-female
- `mascot-sleeping`: System status card: sleeping robot with its warm glow (104dp)
- `avatar-assistant`: Meet Your Assistant card: the assistant persona with the orb badge (84 × 94 compact, 96 × 108 banner)
- `crown-gold`: Monetization: 3D gold crown (supplied still; animated in code by AnimatedCrown until the rotating video is exported), paywall hero (64dp), Unlock All Details (56dp), Congratulations (100dp)
- `premium-glow`: Premium glow: the cream-gold radial with soft light rings behind premium cards (value sheet, quota card). Light theme; dark uses the coded black-gold gradient
- `assistant-phone`: Experiment (Component 25): 3D phone with sparkles on the AI Assistant toggle instead of the robot (36dp). The robot stays the default
- `illustration-search`: Search empty state: the robot with a magnifier and sparkles; "Search across your calls" (200dp)
- `illustration-no-internet`: No-internet state: 3D wifi with a red strike; "No internet connection" (140dp). Reusable on any screen that needs the network
- `illustration-no-results`: No-results state: the robot thinking with a question mark; "No results found" (160dp)
